items.title: ACKNOWLEDGING THE KING
items.quote: All nations, clap your hands! Sing out to G-d with a joyful cry!
items.text: Let all nations join us in acknowledging Hashem as King over mankind.

items.quote: Hashem is the Most High. [His power is] awesome. [He is the] great King over all the earth.

items.title: THE SHOFAR
items.quote: G-d [Elokim] ascended with the teruah blast, [the Name of] Hashem, with the sound of the shofar.
items.text: Hashem’s Name of loving mercy is ascending with the steady, calming tekiah sound of the shofar.

items.title: APPRECIATION
items.quote: Sing to G-d with music, sing! Sing to our King, sing!
items.text: Let all nations join us in loyal devotion and enthusiastic appreciation of Hashem’s kindness to His creatures.

items.quote: For G-d is King of all the world. Sing, with meaning!

items.title: RECOGNITION
items.quote: The virtuous nobles among the nations have gathered [to acknowledge] the people of Avraham’s G-d.
items.text: There will be universal recognition of the essential benefit that Yisrael has brought to the world.
